texts: Light roast coffee actually has MORE caffeine than dark roast — despite what most people believe. The longer roasting process breaks down caffeine molecules, meaning your bold-tasting dark roast is milder in the stimulant department.

Arabica beans contain nearly half the caffeine of Robusta beans — that's why Robusta is the choice for cheap instant coffee and espresso blends seeking a stronger kick. Arabica's lower caffeine gives it the smoother, more complex flavor specialty coffee lovers pay premium prices for.

A 12-ounce cold brew concentrate contains roughly 200mg of caffeine — more than double a standard 8-ounce drip coffee — yet it tastes smoother and less bitter, making it dangerously easy to overconsume without realizing how much caffeine you're actually drinking.
